legend.body: a–c, Precon1; d–f, Precon4; g–i, Precon4 − Precon1. Each ring holds the 6 regions (open, a region no pair reaches with at least 4 rats); each edge is one of the 15 pairs tested, curving toward the centre, its width the mean change in coherence from Baseline (20 s) to Cue 1 + Cue 2 (20 s) over the rats (Dickson 2022: 59–61 Hz notch, hanning(1024), 512 overlap, 2,048 points, averaged over 30–90 Hz without 59–61 Hz), orange for an increase and purple for a decrease. Left column, the increases; middle, the decreases; right, both. Under each ring, its statistic (the summed increases, the summed decreases, or the sum of all) against every way of flipping the sign of each rat’s change (256 sign patterns; the rat is the unit, as in the mixed model that lit tab 8’s light), the vertical line the observed value, with its rank among them and its exact P (the share at least as extreme; with 8 rats P moves in steps of 1/256, so the smallest possible is 1/256 for the increases or the decreases and 2/256 for both; increases one-sided upward, decreases downward, both two-sided; *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001; uncorrected). n = 8 rats, 8 trials per session. legend.title: Baseline (20 s) → both cues, gamma 30–90 Hz: the connectome of the change from Baseline (20 s) to Cue 1 + Cue 2 (20 s).
legend.body: a–c, Precon1; d–f, Precon4; g–i, Precon4 − Precon1. Each ring holds the 6 regions (open, a region no pair reaches with at least 4 rats); each edge is one of the 15 pairs tested, curving toward the centre, its width the mean change in coherence from Baseline (20 s) to Cue 1 + Cue 2 (20 s) over the rats (Dickson 2022: 59–61 Hz notch, hanning(1024), 512 overlap, 2,048 points, averaged over 30–90 Hz without 59–61 Hz), orange for an increase and purple for a decrease. legend.title: Baseline (20 s) → both cues, gamma, R DHC – R RSC: direction.
legend.body: a, the pair on the ring of regions (the arrow, the direction measured). Then, for each measure: its value for each rat at Baseline (20 s) and Cue 1 + Cue 2 (20 s) on Precon1 (grey) and Precon4 (black), each rat's two windows joined, the mean ± s.e.m. beside them; each rat's change between the days, (Precon4 Cue 1 + Cue 2 (20 s) − Baseline (20 s)) − (Precon1 Cue 1 + Cue 2 (20 s) − Baseline (20 s)), with the mean ± 95% confidence interval; and that mean against 10,000 shuffles in which each session's trials had their two windows swapped at random (grey) and against 10,000 sets of fake trials from the same rats' FP1 and FP2, where there were no cues, each session as many as it had real trials, in random order, losing the windows its real trials lost (blue).
